Read any supported movie file by extension

Source: R/read_movie.R
read_movie.Rd

Dispatches to the appropriate reader based on the file extension: .fm2 -> read_fm2(), .bk2 -> read_bk2(), .fcm -> read_fcm(), .lsmv -> read_lsmv(), .gmv -> read_gmv(), .vbm -> read_vbm(), .m64 -> read_m64(), .smv -> read_smv(), .pxm -> read_pxm(), .pjm -> read_pjm(), .dtm -> read_dtm().

Usage

read_movie(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a movie file.

Value

A replayr_movie object.

Details

Returns a replayr_movie regardless of source format. The header[["_format"]] field records which parser ran. The inputs array is (n_frames, n_players, n_buttons); n_buttons varies per platform (8 NES, 12 SNES, 15 Genesis, 28 N64/GC, 30 PSX).

See also

supported_formats()
